headline: Frequent Reworks in Form Handling Logic
diagnosis: The recent commit messages indicate a recurring theme of fixing and enhancing form handling, particularly around optional and nullable fields. This suggests that the current implementation may have underlying issues or complexities that are not well understood or documented, leading to frequent modifications.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the form handling logic in utils.py, focusing on the areas related to optional and nullable fields.
Identify any patterns or common errors in the recent commits to understand the root causes of the issues being addressed.
Engage with the authors of the recent commits to gather insights on their experiences and challenges with the current implementation.
Document the findings and propose a refactor of the form handling logic to simplify and clarify its behavior, reducing the need for future reworks.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the core team to mitigate bus factor.
